model.name: BUG6: Room detail children collections (Members, Files) are not clickable in /trace drawer.
model.description: BUG (v0.6.10 /trace drawer): the room detail drawer shows Children (collection Members, collection Files) but these collection rows are NOT clickable. They MUST be clickable → clicking navigates to that collection's detail view in the drawer (tree-navigation within the detail drawer). Part of the same broken in-drawer navigation as BUG5 — renderDetailForRef was never wired to child-click events in the detail view.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "the collections in the room detail are not clickable"
model.crossRefNote: BUG5 (drawer stuck on first item) is the same root — renderDetailForRef not wired. BUG6 is the specific case: child collection links in the detail view have no click handler. R20.6c (tap→detail) defines the selection→detail contract.

intendedChain.useCase: detailView.childClickNavigates — clicking a child item/collection in the detail drawer navigates to its detail
intendedChain.test: RED: open room detail in /trace drawer → click 'Members' collection row → assert drawer switches to Members detail. Currently FAILS (not clickable / no navigation).
